name: deepseek_alias_20261104
comment: ANCHOR: DEEPSEEK_ALIAS_20261104 — every surface that can select a DeepSeek model id must offer only ids the model registry accepts: the llm_lane routing set AND the run-manual endpoint's lane map (LANE_TO_POLICY / FLASH_LANES). The legacy v4 ids are removed from both; in llm_lane they survive only in the typed-error set, and on the run-manual endpoint they now return POLICY_NOT_ALLOWED. Hermetic: imports only, no network, no provider call (the probe is stubbed).
